svg.title: Pantone reference — green, moss, navy
svg.desc: Each palette colour with its nearest Pantone Solid Coated chip, two alternatives, and the nearest textile TCX chip.
svg.text: Nearest chip for every colour the three palettes declare, and two alternatives for each.
ΔE00 is CIEDE2000 distance from the screen colour: 0 is the same colour, under 3 is indistinguishable.
Hex values are published conversions of Pantone's own L*a*b* data - check a physical chip before printing.
